commands: '=== bindings NOT on the current cert 8CA90463 (stragglers) ==='

Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $s=$_; $s.Bindings.Collection | Where-Object { $_.protocol -eq 'https' } | ForEach-Object { $th=[string]$_.certificateHash; if ($th -notlike '8CA90463*') { "$($s.Name) (id=$($s.Id)) host=$($_.bindingInformation) thumb=$($th.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(12,$th.Length))) state=$($s.State)" } } }
